waText:
🌵 *This weekend in Tesoro Highlands*
Great weekend ahead for the neighborhood—something for everyone.

🌱 *Sat 8:30 AM* — Old Town Newhall Farmers Market (free)
   Fresh local produce, community vibe, perfect Saturday morning.
🏍️ *Sat 9 AM* — Motorcycles and Coffee (free)
   Free, fun gathering for car and bike enthusiasts of all ages.
❄️ *Sat 2 PM* — Disney's Frozen - The Broadway Musical at the Santa Clarita Performing Arts Center
   Frozen comes to life—kids and families will love it.
🎸 *Sat 7 PM* — Concerts in the Park, presented by Logix Federal Credit Union: Top 40 Country
   Live country music in the park, great summer evening out.
🎵 *Sun 1 PM* — Afternoon Acoustic Jam (free)
   Laid-back acoustic jam, free and perfect for adult relaxation.
🎭 *Sun 2 PM* — Coriolanus presented by Santa Clarita Shakespeare 2026 Festival (free)
   Shakespeare outdoors, family-friendly take on a classic play.

Full list → https://tesorohighlands.com/events
